subtopics.name: Potential energy and conservation of energy

questions.stem: A machine gun fires 300 bullets per $\mathrm{min}$ if the mass of each bullet is $10 \mathrm{~g}$ and the velocity of the bullets is $600 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$, the power (in $\mathrm{kW}$ ) of the gun is
questions.solution: The firing rate is $300/60=5$ bullets per second. Each bullet has kinetic energy $\tfrac12(0.010)(600)^2=1800\,\mathrm J$. The power transferred to the bullets is $5\times1800=9000\,\mathrm W=9\,\mathrm{kW}$.
